Real Experience.
Real Results.

This isn't theory from a textbook. When you learn with me, you're learning from someone who has lived and breathed music for over two decades.

From cover bands like Nerds and Cats on a Smooth Surface to pro original projects, I bring real-world performance experience into every lesson, helping you develop not just technical skills, but true musicianship that lasts a lifetime.

Whether you want to have fun playing your favorite songs or pursue serious musical growth, you'll learn quickly and efficiently through my streamlined, structured approach that delivers the best results in the shortest time, all tailored to your level and aspirations.
